scheme_name: Jharkhand Nirman Karmakar Mrityu/Durghatana Sahayata Yojana
description:
The Jharkhand Nirman Karmakar Mrityu/Durghatana Sahayata Yojana is a welfare scheme launched by the Government of Jharkhand. 

This scheme was officially launched on 1st April 2016. 

It is designed to provide financial assistance to the families of construction workers who face unfortunate events such as death or serious accidents. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to ensure that the families of deceased or injured construction workers receive timely financial support. 

The scheme aims to reduce the financial burden on families during times of crisis. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is specifically aimed at helping families cope with the immediate expenses that arise from such unfortunate incidents. 

Under the scheme, a financial assistance of ₹2 lakh is provided to the family of a deceased construction worker. 

In the case of serious accidents that result in permanent disability, the scheme offers a financial assistance of ₹1 lakh. 

The eligibility criteria for this scheme are clearly defined. 

To be eligible, the applicant must be a registered construction worker in Jharkhand. 

The applicant must have been actively engaged in construction work at the time of the incident. 

There are no specific age limits for eligibility under this scheme. 

However, the applicant must provide proof of registration as a construction worker. 

Additionally, the applicant must submit documentation proving the incident that led to the claim. 

The application process for the Jharkhand Nirman Karmakar Mrityu/Durghatana Sahayata Yojana is straightforward. 

Interested applicants must first obtain the application form from the local Labour Department office or the official website of the Jharkhand Labour Department. 

The application form must be filled out with accurate details regarding the deceased or injured worker. 

The applicant must attach necessary documents including the death certificate or medical report confirming the accident. 

Proof of registration as a construction worker must also be included. 

Once the application form is completed along with the required documents, it must be submitted to the local Labour Department office. 

The application will then be reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The timeline for processing applications can vary but is generally completed within 30 days of submission. 

Financial assistance is typically disbursed directly to the bank account of the applicant. 

The scheme is implemented by the Labour, Employment and Training Department of the Government of Jharkhand. 

For any queries or assistance, applicants can contact the Labour Department at their local offices. 

The contact details for the Jharkhand Labour Department can be found on their official website. 

The scheme also aims to raise awareness among construction workers regarding their rights and available benefits. 

As of October 2023, the scheme has provided assistance to thousands of families across the state. 

The government has made efforts to streamline the application process to ensure that assistance reaches beneficiaries without unnecessary delays. 

Regular workshops and awareness programs are conducted to educate construction workers about the scheme. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to improve the welfare of workers in the unorganized sector in Jharkhand. 

The government has allocated a specific budget for the implementation of this scheme each financial year. 

In the financial year 2022-2023, the government allocated ₹50 crore for the welfare of construction workers. 

This allocation is intended to cover various welfare schemes including the Mrityu/Durghatana Sahayata Yojana. 

The scheme has been well-received by the public, with many families expressing gratitude for the timely assistance provided. 

The government has also introduced measures to ensure transparency in the disbursement of funds. 

Regular audits are conducted to ensure that the funds are utilized for the intended purpose. 

The scheme has been instrumental in providing a safety net for construction workers and their families. 

It addresses the vulnerabilities faced by workers in the construction industry. 

The construction industry in Jharkhand employs a significant number of workers, many of whom are engaged in precarious work conditions. 

The scheme aims to provide a sense of security to these workers and their families. 

In addition to financial assistance, the government is exploring ways to provide additional support services to beneficiaries. 

These may include counseling services and assistance in finding new employment opportunities. 

The Jharkhand Nirman Karmakar Mrityu/Durghatana Sahayata Yojana is a crucial step towards improving the livelihoods of construction workers. 

It reflects the government's commitment to protecting the rights and welfare of vulnerable workers. 

The scheme is part of a larger framework of labor welfare policies in Jharkhand. 

The government continues to monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of the scheme. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is actively sought to improve the implementation process. 

The scheme is expected to evolve based on changing needs and circumstances of construction workers in the state. 

Overall, the Jharkhand Nirman Karmakar Mrityu/Durghatana Sahayata Yojana serves as a vital support system for families affected by the loss or injury of a construction worker. 

It exemplifies the government's proactive approach to labor welfare in the state of Jharkhand. 

The scheme is a testament to the importance of social security measures for workers in the unorganized sector. 

The government remains committed to enhancing the lives of construction workers through various welfare initiatives. 

The continued success of this scheme will depend on effective implementation and outreach efforts. 

The government aims to ensure that no family is left without support during their time of need. 

In conclusion, the Jharkhand Nirman Karmakar Mrityu/Durghatana Sahayata Yojana is a significant welfare initiative. 

It provides essential financial assistance to the families of construction workers in Jharkhand. 

The scheme is a vital resource for those facing the challenges of loss or serious injury in the workplace.
